      • extract

        public static Map<Long,Map<String,Double>> extract(ij.measure.ResultsTable statistics,
                                                   String columnName)
        Extract the given Results Table column as a map where th key is the id of the object and the value is another map with the statistic as the key and the statistic itself as the value. This helps mostly to create a new statistic more easily. See AddStatsDemo
        Parameters:
        statistics - the results table from which to extract the statistics. The table should have the following columns "Label", "Name", "ID", "Timepoint", "Category". After that you can have the columns you want.
        columnName - The column you want to use for the statistic. Only one column at a time for now
        Returns:
        a double Map that can be used with create(IDataItemPrx, String, Map)

      • create

        public static StatsCreator create(Imaris.IDataItemPrx item,
                                  String statName,
                                  Map<Long,Map<String,Double>> statValues)
        Used in conjunction with extract(ResultsTable, String) this allows to prepare a new statistic to be added into the Imaris object. Use the methods of StatsCreator to set more information about the statistic such as the channel, unit and category.
        Parameters:
        item - the item to which to append statistics
        statName - the name of the statistic we wish to add. This is how you will see it in Imaris
        statValues - the actual statistics to add. Each key is the id of the object each value is a Map where the key is the name of the statistic and the value is the numerical value of the statistic
        Returns:
        the same object, to continue with optional parameter configuration
